question: What are the baselines used in the paper?

answer.free_form_answer: GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia Corpus with ensembling, and GloVe vectors trained on Airbnb Data without ensembling

title: Using General Adversarial Networks for Marketing: A Case Study of Airbnb
answer_short: The baseline used in the paper is a recurrent neural network with long short-term memory gates (RNN/LSTM) trained to predict listing popularity based on descriptions.
answer_rationale: The paper explicitly states that prior to building the generative adversarial network (GAN), they built an RNN/LSTM model to predict listing popularity based on descriptions (Text 17). This model served as a baseline before introducing the GAN with the DMK loss function (Text 19).
